message.traumacraft.not_applicable: This item cannot treat that injury
jei.traumacraft.bandage: Stops light or heavy bleeding on one selected body part. Pick up a bandage in inventory and click a body part in the TraumaCraft anatomy panel, or right-click to automatically treat the worst bleeding.
jei.traumacraft.splint: Fixes one broken limb. Pick up a splint and click the fractured body part in your inventory anatomy panel, or right-click to treat the first fracture.
jei.traumacraft.medkit: Restores 25 local HP to one body part. Hold on inventory cursor and click a body part in the anatomy panel to select it, or right-click to treat your most damaged body part.
